2 You are provided with two solids, solid N and solid O. Do the following tests on solid N and solid O,
recording all of your observations at each stage.

solid N ______

tests on solid N

tests on solid O
Divide solid O into two portions.
Place the first portion of solid O in a test-tube. Add about 4cm of distilled water to the test-tube.
Stopper and shake the test-tube to dissolve solid O.
Divide the solution into two equal portions in two test-tubes.

parts.label: (g)
parts.text:
Add an excess of aqueous sodium hydroxide to the first portion of the solution.
Record your observations.

parts.label: (h)
parts.text:
Add a few drops of dilute nitric acid and about 1cm of aqueous silver nitrate to the second
portion of the solution.
Record your observations.

parts.label: (i)
parts.text:

Record your observations.

Identify solid O.
